Samira Patel: Quick ask — candidate for infra engineer is on Thursday 10am PT and we just lost one panelist. Can someone pick up the 10:20-10:40 slot?

Evan Li: I can slide in if it's just behavioral + infra. Any scoring anchors I should use?

Samira Patel: Thanks Evan! Mostly system design + reliability questions. For scoring, use the usual 1-5 scale but focus on troubleshooting examples and ownership.

Maya Chen: I can cover the behavioral half (10:20-10:30) but I won't be able to stay past 10:35. If Evan can take the deep tech follow-up that works.

Jordan R.: I can be debrief owner if we get full notes. Quick request — can someone paste the anchor examples in thread so reviewers score consistently?

Evan Li: Yup — here's what I usually refer to:
```
Reliability (1-5):
1 = no real infra experience, fuzzy on failure modes
3 = clear examples of debugging incidents, some ownership
5 = owned and mitigated production incidents, drove changes that improved SLOs

Troubleshooting (1-5):
1 = struggles to form hypothesis / triage steps
3 = proposes reasonable isolation steps and metrics to check
5 = rapid hypothesis, can propose remediation & long-term fix
```

Samira Patel: Perfect — can People Ops attach the candidate packet after this? Also, note: candidate timezone is UTC-7. Calendar shows PT, double-check before joining.

People Ops Bot: @here Candidate packet for "Infra Eng — 2nd round" uploaded: https://example.com/candidate/packet/abcd. Calendar event: 2026-04-02 10:00-10:45 PT. Reminder set 30m before. :white_check_mark:

Maya Chen: Got the packet. I'll cover 10:20-10:30 and drop a summary in the debrief doc. Evan, can you pick 10:30-10:40?

Evan Li: Yep I’ll take 10:30-10:40 and focus on incident troubleshooting. Jordan, I'll ping you immediately after for the debrief notes link.

Jordan R.: Thanks — I'll own the debrief and collect scores. Quick ask: please add one sentence of evidence per score (e.g., "gave example of rollback after bad deploy") so we can automate the summary.

Samira Patel: Amazing. TL;DR: Maya covers 10:20-10:30, Evan 10:30-10:40, Jordan debrief owner. People Ops linked candidate packet. Anything else?

Maya Chen: One more ask — can someone confirm recording is enabled for notes?

People Ops Bot: Recording is enabled for this meeting per team policy. Link will be attached to the debrief doc automatically after meeting. :movie_camera:

Evan Li: All set from my side. I'll paste scoring anchors into the debrief doc after the interview.

Samira Patel: Thanks everyone — closing the loop. :pray:
